reason: Both plans satisfy all hard requirements, but Response B sequences steps more consistently (replication setup and dry run occur before the pre-cutover backup, with backup clearly preceding the actual data sync/CDC start, without the internal contradiction Response A has by claiming its backup precedes replication touching production slots even though tooling setup is listed as an earlier step). Response B also adds a distinct final freeze-notice communication and a post-verification smoke-test step, and its rollback procedure more carefully addresses partial-failure states (data modified only in cloud) than Response A's.
